text:
miguel: Heads up - eu2 dedicated pool d-slice-12 showing sustained tail latency on small gen workloads since 08:02 UTC. Tenant 'newsfeed-inc' spike correlated with GPU mem upswing and NIC egress bursts.
anna: ugh, saw the alerts. Is it noisy neighbor (KV cache churn) or a NIC/egress problem?
miguel: telemetry points at KV cache churn + bursty egress during big embed requests. GPU util stays ok but latency jumps for small seqs.
priya: can we soft-quarantine the tenant to a spare fractional slice? we have a couple of fractional-slices in eu2 warm pool.
tom: fractional slices are thin right now, though. If we migrate, we risk disrupting their thruput. Alternative: add an egress policer on the tenant to smooth their bursts (rate-limit at proxy).
li: +1 egress policer; also thinking of bumping their qos weight down temporarily so scheduler prefers other tenants for hot-slot allocation.
rachel: quick cost note: moving to dedicated spare increases per-token cost ~35% for now. Egress shaping is cheaper but needs proxy config change and testing.
miguel: prefer minimal blast radius. let's try egress policer first. tom—can you push a canary config?
tom: I'll push a canary to eu2 proxy group 'slice-proxy-eu2-canary' with this rule:
```
match: tenant == "newsfeed-inc"
policer:
  rate: 1500 req/s
  burst: 300
action: smooth
```
I will add a 10m rollback window.
anna: also enable kv-cache-preserve for their hot prefixes for 5m to avoid cold-start churn (controlled via placement hints).
priya: ops-bot: deploy canary?
ops-bot: noted. Can deploy in 2m. Please confirm owners and SLOs to annotate.
miguel: owners = @priya @tom. SLO impact: potential 5% higher p99 on their long requests during canary.
li: if policer doesn't work in 10m, plan B = live-migrate heavy shards to a warmed fractional slice and enable preemptible fallback on low-priority tasks.
rachel: i'll draft a short cost/impact memo for infra leadership + product so we can approve migration if needed.
priya: doing live metrics baseline capture now (prom queries and tcpdump samples). will post charts in 5m. :mag_right:
miguel: thanks. keeping this thread for timeline: canary start 08:12, check 08:22, decision at 08:25.
anna: fyi we should add a followup ticket to tune our autoplace heuristics: prefer isolating bursty embedding tenants into narrower NIC-limited slices.
miguel: agreed. I'll open infra issue with telemetry snippets after we stabilize.
ops-bot: canary deployed at 08:12 UTC to slice-proxy-eu2-canary by tom. Rollback timer set for 10m.
